Year-end scorecard for the practice. Composite results for all discretionary client accounts for the periods ending December 31, 2025: 1 year 11.2% gross, 10.1% net; 5 years 7.8% gross, 6.7% net; 10 years 8.4% gross, 7.3% net (5- and 10-year figures are average annual returns). Net figures deduct the 1.00% annual advisory fee charged to every client plus all trading costs, and results include realized and unrealized gains. Proud of the discipline behind these numbers, and grateful to the families who trust me with them.
